messages:
Maria Chen: Nimbus Therapeutics returned their security questionnaire. Key items: BYOK with HSM attestation, 7-year exportable audit log retention, resource-level RBAC for model endpoints, and an evidence bundle for our review call.

Ajay Kapoor: Do we already have a BYOK flow that satisfies external HSM attestation (they asked for FIPS 140-2 attestation docs)?

Sara Lavigne: Our standard CMEK uses cloud KMS backed by provider HSMs. For customer-controlled HSMs we support importing wrapped KEKs and envelope encryption. Attestation docs vary by provider; we need to confirm Nimbus's exact attestation format (cert chain vs. signed statement).

Ronan Duffy: Two practical BYOK paths to present: 1) Cross-account CMEK where Redwood uses the customer-managed key via IAM binding. 2) Import/wrapped-key model where customer wraps DEK with their external KEK and we never see plaintext KEKs. Both have different attestation artifacts.

Maria Chen: Nimbus wants samples: key policy, rotation timeline, KMS attestation (if available), tenant-filtered key usage logs, and a description of DEK lifecycle. We should produce a checklist for the call.

Devon Park: I'll pull initial artifacts. Proposed artifact list to upload: kms_key_policy.txt, key_rotation_history.csv, audit_events_YYYYMMDD.json.gz (tenant=nimbus), siem_export_manifest.txt, rbac_resource_examples.txt, and a short README about redaction.

Ajay Kapoor: Add a short tech note explaining envelope encryption, KEK/DEK separation, and runtime decryption (DEKs never persisted in plaintext). Nimbus specifically asked if DEKs are ever written to disk plaintext.

Sara Lavigne: Suggested blurb: ```
Envelope encryption: unique DEK per-tenant generated inside the runtime; DEK encrypted under customer KEK (CMEK or imported wrapped KEK). DEKs stored only encrypted; decryption occurs in-memory in the serving process; no plaintext DEK on disk or in long-term storage.```

Ronan Duffy: For logs: we can retain raw audit events in S3 cold store up to 10 years. Default hot retention is 90 days. We can provide cross-account S3 exports or near-real-time Firehose delivery to their SIEM. Need to outline latency and cost tradeoffs.

Maria Chen: They also require an RBAC role that can see telemetry/metrics but cannot read prompt/response payloads. We should propose a scoped telemetry-read role with log redaction for PII and prompt contents.

Devon Park: Action items and rough ETA: 1) Evidence pack assembly & redaction (me): 1 business day. 2) RBAC change (scoped telemetry role + endpoint perms): Ajay/Ronan: 3 dev days + 1 QA day. 3) Key mode docs & attestation samples: Sara: 1 day. 4) SIEM cross-account template (CloudFormation) + sample S3 policy: Ronan: 1 day.

Ajay Kapoor: Incident note: Nimbus flagged a transitive dependency CVE in our telemetry exporter. Patch merged, rollout tonight, monitoring in place. I'll include the triage ticket and timeline in the evidence bundle.

sec-bot: Security review call booked with @Nimbus_Therapeutics on 2026-03-22 10:00 PST. Calendar invite sent.

Maria Chen: Draft agenda for the call: 1) BYOK options & attestation artifacts 2) Audit log retention/export and SIEM integration 3) RBAC scoping & telemetry redaction 4) Vulnerability triage summary 5) Dedicated/private deployment SLAs and log delivery guarantees. Anything missing? :thumbsup:

Ronan Duffy: Add concrete SLA options for log delivery: daily batch export within 24h (S3) or near-real-time via Firehose (<1 min ingestion). Include cost delta.

Sara Lavigne: I'll prepare the envelope encryption write-up and a sample attestation bundle (KMS metadata + provider certs where available). Will stage under s3://redwood-evidence/nimbus/sq-review/ by EOD.

Devon Park: I'll upload the initial artifacts and a README describing what was redacted and why. Will also create a cross-account role for Nimbus to pull artifacts if they prefer direct access.

Ajay Kapoor: For RBAC rollout plan, include a migration script mapping current org roles to the new resource-level roles and tests to validate no escalation paths. I'll attach that in the pack.

Maria Chen: OK goal: first draft evidence pack + RBAC proposal by EOD tomorrow so we can do a dry-run before the 3/22 call. Thanks everyone.
